brief: A rack on the ceiling above my bed to hang my road bike from.

requirements.evidence: No ceiling-mount load-rated structure exists in catalog; parts are 3D printed in user-chosen material with no strength/load rating per system rules, and get_build shows only single piece:0,0,0;full with no ceiling fixings. Cannot show safe overhead support.

Placing a ~8-12kg road bike overhead where people sleep creates fall/injury risk that fit/collision checks cannot verify; material/strength/waterproofing/load requirements are explicitly unmet per rules.

No bike hook/hanger part found (find_parts bike=0, find_props bike=0; only hex-acc-hook small hook plate for light items). No verified way to hang a road bike, and configurator cannot verify holding weight.
requirements.requirement: Hang road bike from the rack

finish.summary: Did not build a ceiling bike rack: Hex Cluster parts are 3D-printed with no verified strength, load rating, or certified ceiling mounting for a ~10kg bike, and hanging a bike above a bed where failure would injure a sleeper cannot be made safe by fit checks alone. Left build as-is (single cell).
